method: Same-agent English/Marathi block-by-block close reading, reverse reconstruction of all four derivability/consistency claims and both directions of the central biconditional, followed by exact formula, macro, token, label and reference comparison. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: Axiomatic derivability and consistency: removal of a derived added assumption, equivalence between proving A and inconsistency after adding not-A, explicit contradiction, and exhaustion by the A and not-A extensions.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The section develops derivability facts needed for completeness. If Gamma derives A and Gamma with A derives falsity, reflexivity supplies every member of Gamma, the hypothesis supplies A, and transitivity transfers the falsity derivation back to Gamma.
samples.checks: The proposition direction, set extension, universal membership claim, reflexivity and transitivity references, and falsity conclusion are exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma proves A only if Gamma with not-A is inconsistent: monotonicity retains A, reflexivity yields not-A, the negation axiom yields not-A-implies-(A-implies-falsity), and two meta-level modus-ponens steps yield falsity.
samples.checks: The biconditional order, both extended-set derivability claims, negation-axiom formula and two modus-ponens applications are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Conversely, inconsistency of Gamma with not-A and the Deduction Theorem give not-A-implies-falsity. The falsity and double-negation axioms plus modus ponens yield A. The exercise asks for the dual statement. If Gamma proves A while not-A belongs to Gamma, the same negation axiom and two modus-ponens steps derive falsity.
samples.checks: All three axiom references, both double-negation formulas, the dual exercise, membership condition and final falsity sequent remain exact.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If both Gamma with A and Gamma with not-A are inconsistent, then Gamma is inconsistent. The proof is left as an exercise and repeated in the protected first-order and propositional problem variants.
samples.checks: Both premise extensions, conclusion, exercise status, tag wrappers and four-part references are preserved.

source_observations: The source's use of iff is translated with the established तेव्हा आणि केवळ तेव्हाच construction in both biconditional statements.
The first proof uses proof-theoretic transitivity over derivations rather than semantic consequence; every displayed Proves relation is preserved.
All formulas, macros, tokens, labels, identifiers and reference options match exactly, with no source correction required.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
सिद्धतायोग्यता remains a definition-controlled formal compound under T184.
The final exhaustion proposition and the dual biconditional are intentionally left as exercises in the source.
